facts.text: The lab reports on enzyme activity are due this Thursday.
The teacher is away on Friday, which is why the reports are due Thursday.
Students may work in groups of three but each student submits their own write-up.
Late reports lose ten percent per day.
The unit test is next Tuesday.

A review session is on Wednesday after school at 3:30 in room 204.

must_not.text: The unit test is open book (never stated).
Extra credit will be offered (the teacher has not decided).

uncertain.text: Whether extra credit will be offered is undecided; the teacher may say next week.

facts.text: Dinner at grandma's is on Saturday at six o'clock.
Grandma asked for a salad and some bread to be brought.

Dad is driving himself to grandma's.

uncertain.text: Whether Aunt Rosa is coming is not confirmed; she has not said for sure.

must_not_after.text: Aunt Rosa's attendance is presented as confirmed.
Any changed plan (time, place, or who brings what) is invented after the closing remarks.
